name: awesome-huggingface
desc: 🤗 A list of wonderful open-source projects & applications integrated with Hugging Face libraries.

resources.name: transformers
resources.desc: State-of-the-art natural language processing for Jax, PyTorch and TensorFlow.

resources.name: datasets
resources.desc: The largest hub of ready-to-use NLP datasets for ML models with fast, easy-to-use and efficient data manipulation tools.

resources.name: tokenizers
resources.desc: Fast state-of-the-Art tokenizers optimized for research and production.

resources.name: knockknock
resources.desc: Get notified when your training ends with only two additional lines of code.

resources.name: accelerate
resources.desc: A simple way to train and use PyTorch models with multi-GPU, TPU, mixed-precision.

resources.name: autonlp
resources.desc: Train state-of-the-art natural language processing models and deploy them in a scalable environment automatically.

resources.name: nn_pruning
resources.desc: Prune a model while finetuning or training.

resources.name: huggingface_hub
resources.desc: Client library to download and publish models and other files on the huggingface.co hub.

resources.name: tune
resources.desc: A benchmark for comparing Transformer-based models.

resources.name: Graph4NLP
resources.desc: Enabling easy use of Graph Neural Networks for NLP.

resources.name: Lightning Transformers
resources.desc: Transformers with PyTorch Lightning interface.

resources.name: Adapter Transformers
resources.desc: Extension to the Transformers library, integrating adapters into state-of-the-art language models.

resources.name: Obsei
resources.desc: A low-code AI workflow automation tool and performs various NLP tasks in the workflow pipeline.

resources.name: Flair
resources.desc: A very simple framework for state-of-the-art NLP.

resources.name: torchdistill
resources.desc: PyTorch-based modular, configuration-driven framework for knowledge distillation.

resources.name: Styleformer
resources.desc: A neural language style transfer framework to transfer text smoothly between styles.

resources.name: ConSERT
resources.desc: A contrastive framework for self-supervised sentence representation transfer.

resources.name: conv-emotion
resources.desc: Implementation of different architectures for emotion recognition in conversations.

resources.name: Gramformer
resources.desc: A framework for detecting, highlighting and correcting grammatical errors on natural language text.

resources.name: dl-translate
resources.desc: A deep learning-based translation library based on HF Transformers.

resources.name: s3prl
resources.desc: A self-supervised speech pre-training and representation learning toolkit.

resources.name: speechbrain
resources.desc: A PyTorch-based speech toolkit.

resources.name: trl
resources.desc: Fine-tune transformers using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to align with human preferences.

resources.name: Spotlight
resources.desc: Interactively explore your HF dataset with one line of code. Use model results (e.g. embeddings, predictions) to understand critical data segments and model failure modes.

resources.name: Jina Integration
resources.desc: Jina integration of Hugging Face Accelerated API.

resources.name: Amazon SageMaker
resources.desc: Making it easier than ever to train Hugging Face Transformer models in Amazon SageMaker.

resources.name: Qualcomm
resources.desc: Collaboration on enabling Transformers in Snapdragon.

resources.name: Intel
resources.desc: Collaboration with Intel for configuration options.
